lessons.title: Origins — Arkansas Roots, Church Choir, Memphis Sound

body.text: Memphis Sound Goals: Teach background + foundation. “What does his voice feel like — warm? close? soft?”

body.label: Key points
items: Born in Arkansas, raised in a religious household
Sang gospel as a kid → vocal control & emotion learned early
Moved to Grand Rapids, then discovered by Willie Mitchell
Signed to Hi Records → the “Memphis Sound” becomes his signature
Guitar + strings + organ = the Al Green formula
